channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Three forgotten kings may reshape ancient Assyrian history
item.description: Clues from tablets and inscriptions suggest three previously unknown Assyrian kings ruled over 2,700 years ago, potentially changing historical timelines.

item.title: Genes may influence cholesterol response to low-carb diets
item.description: People with genetic predisposition to high cholesterol may see sharper LDL increases on low-carb diets, especially with certain food choices.

item.title: Researchers introduce AI education to elementary school classrooms
item.description: Researchers talk about the difficulties of teaching AI basics to young students and how their efforts resulted in a competition win.

item.title: NSF funds eight quantum research institutes with $290 million
item.description: Eight research institutes aim to understand and harness quantum properties, with a combined investment of more than $290 million.
